_note: Isonade v5 build spec. Generated by isonade_v5.ts --write-spec; offline engine-tested, NOT pushed. Ids are placeholders (iso-*).

conditions.description: Does not have a summon active

iso-it-rises.name: It Rises
iso-it-rises.description: Black water churns around Isonade every turn. Harmless.

iso-barnacle-hide.name: Barnacle Hide
iso-barnacle-hide.description: Barnacles close over its hide: a shield that soaks your hits.

iso-tide-draws-back.name: The Tide Draws Back
iso-tide-draws-back.description: The water pulls away from the shore and gathers into it. Its next hit, the Breaker, is huge. Clear it now.
iso-tide-draws-back.battleDescription: The water pulls away from the shore and gathers around %user.

iso-brine-brand.name: Brine Brand
iso-brine-brand.description: It brands you with brine. Its next hit, the Undertow, will crush you. Cleanse it now.

effects.description: Brine Brand: no healing or lifesteal until cleansed

iso-the-swell.name: The Swell
iso-the-swell.description: The sea rears up behind it. In two turns the Tidal Bore crashes over you: Smoke it now, or brace.

iso-the-swell-rises.name: The Swell Rises
iso-the-swell-rises.description: The wave stands over the hold. It breaks next turn.
iso-the-swell-rises.battleDescription: The wave stands over the hold.

iso-breaker.name: Breaker
iso-breaker.description: The wave breaks over you. Then it hangs exposed for a round.

iso-harpoon-line.name: Harpoon Line
iso-harpoon-line.description: It spits the old harpoon back through you. Goes through damage reduction and shields.

iso-black-water-mark.name: Black Water
iso-black-water-mark.description: Everything but the floating crates is marked red. Black water fills the room next turn.
iso-black-water-mark.battleDescription: The water goes still and black. Only the floating crates stay pale.

iso-black-water.name: Black Water
iso-black-water.description: Black water fills every hex but the crates; then it surfaces to feed.
iso-black-water.battleDescription: Black water crashes down. %user surfaces to feed.

iso-the-deep.name: The Deep
iso-the-deep.description: It sinks under black water behind a heavy shield. Break the shield before its next turn, or the whole room floods.
iso-the-deep.battleDescription: %user sinks out of sight. The whole hold goes black.

iso-the-deep-crash.name: The Deep
iso-the-deep-crash.description: The shield held: the black water crashes over the whole room and washes Isonade clean.
iso-the-deep-crash.battleDescription: Black water rises to the ceiling and crashes down on %target.

iso-the-deep-surface.name: The Deep
iso-the-deep-surface.description: Its shield broken, it surfaces gasping and exposed.
iso-the-deep-surface.battleDescription: %user surfaces through its broken shell, gasping.

iso-scour.name: Scour
iso-scour.description: The undertow tears your buffs away.

iso-shed.name: Shed
iso-shed.description: It sheds its outer skin and every debuff with it.
iso-shed.battleDescription: %user sheds a skin of rotten barnacles.

iso-drowned-anchor.name: Drowned Anchor
iso-drowned-anchor.description: It swings the anchor chain it swallowed. Follows a Scour or a Shed.

iso-silt-cloud.name: Silt Cloud
iso-silt-cloud.description: It churns up silt and braces: it takes far less damage next round.
iso-silt-cloud.battleDescription: %user thrashes and braces. Silt clouds the hold.

iso-grasping-arm-rises.battleDescription: The deck bursts upward. A wet black arm rises out of it.
iso-grasping-arm-rises.description: An arm bursts up through the deck and lashes everything around it. Cut it, and another grows.
iso-grasping-arm-rises.name: Grasping Arm

iso-arm-lash.name: Arm Lash
iso-arm-lash.description: The arm sweeps every hex around it.
iso-arm-lash.battleDescription: The arm lashes across the planks.
